CF_API_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare API token with **Account > Account Analytics > Read** only.

CF_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Cloudflare Account ID for the Web Analytics account.

DASHBOARD_PASSWORD.description: Password used to protect the private analytics dashboard with Basic Auth.

CF_SITE_TAG.description: Optional Web Analytics siteTag. Leave empty to auto-detect from the configured request host.

DASHBOARD_USER.description: Optional dashboard username. Defaults to admin.
